name: Zombie Rush

comments.author: StalkingKraken42
comments.content: This game is awesome! Auto-guns and hordes of zombies? Sign me up!

comments.author: QuickRevolver_Z
comments.content: Zombie Rush is surprisingly addictive. Like, seriously, I can't stop playing!

comments.author: AmongUsWithSkills
comments.content: Is it just me, or does this get ridiculously hard? The zombie waves are relentless.

comments.author: ShadowKatana_X
comments.content: Love the roguelike elements! Each run feels fresh and exciting, gotta enhance my skills.

comments.author: NoobMaster8000
comments.content: LOL, I keep dying, but I keep coming back! This game has a certain charm, you know?

comments.author: Xx_DarkAura_xX
comments.content: Seriously good. The automatic weapons make you feel like a badass against the undead.

comments.author: PhantomLeviathan99
comments.content: Gotta go fast, gotta survive! This game tests your reflexes. Can I survive another wave?

comments.author: SavageBroadsword_M
comments.content: The gems you earn for killing zombies are really useful in this game, upgrading is critical.

comments.author: EldenRingBearer
comments.content: Zombie Rush, eh? Never thought I'd enjoy killing zombies this much. What a blast!

comments.author: CosmicPhoenix87
comments.content: This is a simple but fun game. It Gets challenging and the zombies are relentless.

userInputText: Zombie Rush 是一款 Roguelike 动作游戏，您可以扮演不同的英雄，在僵尸浪潮中杀出一条血路！每个英雄都将自己的能力带到战场上，你可以使用杀死僵尸获得的宝石来增强这些能力。配备自动枪械，你需要快速移动以避免受到任何伤害来领导战斗！当你继续战斗时，你会变得更强大，发现新的福利，并增强你的特殊技能。你玩的越多，游戏的挑战性就越大，危险的僵尸也越来越多。考验你的技巧和勇气的时候到了！
